condition: Owner approval of ODR-004 was conditional on the market-data security, authority and fail-closed checks passing, with scope_providers kept empty

local_verification.pytest_full: 5025 passed, 22 skipped, 13 pre-existing warnings (nautilus Timestamp.utcnow, pydantic serializer, tarfile filter); none from market-data modules
local_verification.mypy: 692 source files clean (Windows); invest, dashboard_api and market_data clean with --platform linux
local_verification.dashboard: typecheck clean, 61 node tests passed, build ok
local_verification.browser_e2e: synthetic temporary root with mocked transport: refresh produced PARTIAL_INDICATIVE_VALUATION through PPDS; a failing provider produced no current market view

defects_found_and_fixed: QuotePolicy evaluated 'now' once before provider retrieval, so every quote retrieved later was rejected as FUTURE_TIMESTAMP; the clock is now re-read after each provider fetch
The HTTP adapters were first placed in acash.invest, which the existing network-free guard forbids; they moved to acash.market_data without weakening the guard

checks.requirement: egress allowlist: https, exact host, no port/userinfo/fragment, fixed path, allowlisted query keys and header names, value charset; trading/account/paper endpoints and SSRF variants refused; transport re-checks every request, no redirects or proxies

authority: ODR-004 must be RATIFIED by OWNER with an ISO date, require ODR-001, and list a provider exactly once with entitlement and display attested; otherwise no adapter is constructed and no request is sent

fail-closed parsing: malformed, non-positive, NaN, mis-attributed, adjusted, duplicated or out-of-range provider data raises DataContractError; HTTP 401/403/429/5xx and network failures map to explicit codes; rate limits stop requests

valuation: missing components are counted and excluded, never valued as zero; PPDS is the only valuation authority; saved snapshot, capacity and transactions are unchanged; failed refresh keeps the previous view; missing FX publishes prices without a view
local API: Host/Origin/session checks, JSON-only POST with empty body, refresh rate limit and single-flight lock; status responses carry no secrets

limitations: No real provider request has been made; every adapter is verified against mocked transports only
BOT host, path, header and field names are unconfirmed against a live response (BOT_SPEC_VERIFIED is False)
Provider entitlement, display and caching rights are not verified for any provider
rollback: Set status in docs/governance/ODR_UPI_MARKET_DATA_004.json to REVOKED (closes the gate immediately) or revert the ratification commit
